# HackMD

> HackMD is a real-time collaborative Markdown editor and knowledge-sharing platform designed for teams, developers, and enterprises.

HackMD provides a comprehensive workspace for collaborative documentation, technical writing, and knowledge management with features including real-time editing, GitHub integration, LaTeX/MathJax support, UML diagrams, and multiple viewing modes (Book, Slide, Dark Mode). The platform serves individual developers, teams, and enterprises with tiered pricing and robust API capabilities.

## Key Topics

- Markdown editor
- Real-time collaboration
- GitHub integration
- API documentation
- Team workspace
- Knowledge sharing
- UML diagrams
- MathJax/LaTeX
- Book Mode
- Slide Mode
- Enterprise features
- Developer tools
- Version control
- Web3 community
- Documentation

- [Basic Markdown Formatting](https://hackmd.io/c/tutorials/%2F%40docs%2Fbasic_formatting_en): Tutorial on basic Markdown formatting and text editor usage in HackMD
- [GitHub Sync Integration](https://hackmd.io/c/tutorials/%2F%40docs%2Fsync-a-note-with-github): Tutorial on syncing HackMD notes with GitHub repositories for version control
- [MathJax and UML Diagrams](https://hackmd.io/c/tutorials/%2F%40docs%2Fuse-mathjax-and-UML-en): Tutorial on using MathJax and UML diagrams in HackMD for technical documentation
- [Creating Books](https://hackmd.io/c/tutorials/%2F%40docs%2Fcreate-a-book-en): Tutorial guide for creating and organizing books in HackMD Book Mode
- [Personal Profile Pages](https://hackmd.io/c/tutorials/%2F%40docs%2Fpersonal-profile-page-en): Tutorial on creating and customizing personal profile pages in HackMD
